title: 轻微外观划痕保留商品并完成部分退款
initial_message: Hello, my black OUTON floor lamp from order $order_number has a small scuff on the back of the base. It is hardly visible where the lamp stands, and the lamp seems to work normally. I paid $price_text and would rather keep it than pack everything up. Is there a reasonable adjustment you can offer?

steps.text: 核对订单、实付及问题范围，确认是否仅为外观瑕疵。
expected_actions: 查询绑定订单和灯具型号；询问划痕范围及是否还有异常，确认客户保留意向。
forbidden_actions: 不得未获客户同意便创建退款；不得把外观划痕解释成无依据的安全结论。
steps.reference_reply: I can look at a partial refund if you would prefer to keep the lamp. Is the scuff the only issue, and have you noticed any other damage or problems with normal use?

steps.text: Yes, it is just a short mark on the paint at the back of the base. The box was fine and nothing else looks damaged. The light and controls have worked normally. I would keep it if you could tell me the exact refund amount first.
expected_actions: 将客户补充限制为外观问题；金额尚未同意。

steps.text: 按实付计算不超过20%的保留商品部分退款选项。
expected_actions: 提出 $partial_text 的部分退款，说明保留商品、原支付渠道退款，并等待客户明确金额币种接受。
forbidden_actions: 不得超过20%上限；不得将询问金额当成接受。
steps.reference_reply: We can offer a partial refund of $partial_text to your original payment method, and you would keep the lamp. Please confirm whether you accept that amount.

steps.text: I accept the partial refund of $partial_text to my original payment method and will keep the lamp. I do not need a replacement or a return. Thank you for spelling that out.
expected_actions: 记录客户对具体金额、币种和保留商品的明确接受。

steps.text: 客户接受后创建唯一部分退款内部申请。
expected_actions: 复核累计退款和待处理金额，按 $partial 创建本问题的退款内部待办。
回复仅说明已提交处理，保留对结果的查询。
forbidden_actions: Agent 不得直接执行支付；不得同时建立换货或全额退款申请。
steps.reference_reply: Thank you. I have submitted the $partial_text partial refund for processing. I will check the payment result before confirming completion.

steps.text: 支付渠道已受理这笔部分退款，尚无成功回执。
expected_actions: 查询实际申请关联的执行回执，以回执状态更新进度。
forbidden_actions: 不得将受理或失败描述成到账。

steps.text: I can still only see the original charge. Has the $partial_text refund gone through yet, or is it still being processed?
expected_actions: 查原申请及支付回执，不新建申请。

steps.text: 解释受理与退款成功的区别并继续跟进。
expected_actions: 当前仅受理，准确告知尚待支付确认；保留原申请。
forbidden_actions: 不得承诺固定到账天数或把accepted说成succeeded。
steps.reference_reply: The refund has been accepted for processing, but I do not yet have a completed payment confirmation. There is no need to submit it again; I am following the existing refund.

steps.text: 支付回执确认原申请的部分退款成功。
expected_actions: 查询实际申请关联的执行回执，以回执状态更新进度。
forbidden_actions: 不得将受理或失败描述成到账。

steps.text: 确认已获得支付成功回执。
expected_actions: 告知已向原支付渠道完成 $partial_text 的部分退款；等客户核对。
forbidden_actions: 不得把支付成功进一步推断为客户已看到账。
steps.reference_reply: The payment confirmation now shows that the $partial_text partial refund has completed to your original payment method. Please check the refund entry when convenient.

steps.text: The $partial_text credit is showing now. I am keeping the lamp, and that resolves the mark on the base for me. Thanks for following up.
expected_actions: 客户已确认款项和保留商品的处理结果，可建议人工结案。

steps.text: 客服核对部分退款成功回执及客户到账确认，确认无其他补偿待办，人工结案。
expected_actions: 由人工核对客户确认、业务回执及未结待办后标记已解决。
forbidden_actions: Agent 不得自动结案。

outcome: 客户保留原灯具并确认收到不超过实付20%的部分退款，人工结案。
